title: Jharkhand: 3 workers die, 2 injured in accident at NTPC's Tandwa plant
summary: Conveyor belt construction work was underway at North Karanpur Super Thermal Power Project (NKSTPP) in Tandwa when the accident occurred, killing three workers and injuring two others

title: Will Cyclone Akvan hit Andhra Pradesh or Bangladesh? The expert shares his forecast
summary:
Why does the Bay of Bengal produce so many cyclones? Are cyclones becoming more intense because of climate change? And can meteorologists accurately predict where a cyclone will make landfall?

In this interview, veteran meteorologist Prof. S.S.V. Ramakrishna explains the science behind cyclone formation, the role of El Niño, ocean temperatures, river runoff, and climate change. He also discusses why the Bay of Bengal is more cyclone-prone than the Arabian Sea and shares insights into the path and intensity of tropical cyclones.

title: FDA seizes suspected substandard edible oil worth ₹50.27 lakh in Pune district
summary: During the inspection, authorities seized the entire stock of 20,085 litres of edible oil, valued at ₹50.27 lakh, suspecting violations relating to substandard quality and misbranding under the Food Safety and Standards Act

title: The long walk to keep India’s tribal healing system alive
summary: More than 200 tribal healers raised serious concerns over the disappearance of medicinal plants and its impact on their practice at Samvaad-2026, a five-day tribal convention organised by Tata Steel Foundation in Jamshedpur

title: Wanted LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat killed in Kulgam, ending 8-day anti-terror operation
summary:
Security forces have killed wanted Lashkar-e-Taiba terrorist Lateef Bhat in south Kashmir’s Kulgam district, ending an eight-day operation linked to the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel.

Officials said Bhat, a key accused in the attack that injured three CRPF personnel, was tracked down after an intensive manhunt. Security forces reportedly urged him to surrender before launching the final operation.

title: Police threaten couple with fake drug case; Madhya Pradesh CM suspends all six officers involved
summary: A CCTV footage showed some police officers threatening a couple of putting marijuana in their bags to make a fake case during a search at a private hotel in Seoni, Madhya Pradesh

title: Who was Lateef Bhat, LeT militant killed in Kulgam encounter?
summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah said in a post on X that Bhat was Lashkar-e-Taiba’s ‘last known active local terrorist’ in the area
